title: Chrom Was Rejected From Smash Bros Before He Got In
hook:
In 2014 Masahiro Sakurai wrote that Chrom would be just another sword fighter like Marth and Ike, so Fire Emblem Awakening got Robin and Lucina instead. Four years later Chrom joined Smash Ultimate as an Echo Fighter based on Roy. Which Fire Emblem character still deserves a slot?
Gameplay is from Shards of Irsa, a game I'm making.
script: Did you know Chrom from Fire Emblem Awakening was rejected from Smash Bros before he got in? In 2014, Masahiro Sakurai was choosing the fighters for Super Smash Bros for Wii U and 3DS. Chrom was the lead character of Awakening, the newest Fire Emblem at the time. Sakurai wrote in his Famitsu column that he naturally considered adding Chrom, but the decision was not easy. In the end he said Chrom would just be another plain old sword wielder like Marth and Ike. He lacked any unique characteristics. So Awakening got two other fighters instead. Robin made it because mixing a sword with magic tomes felt different from everyone else. Lucina was first planned as one of Marth's alternate costumes, then got her own roster spot because her attacks were slightly different. Chrom was left out of his own game's lineup. Four years later Nintendo fixed it. In August 2018, a Smash Ultimate Direct revealed Chrom as an Echo Fighter based on Roy, and Ultimate launched that December. The hero of Awakening needed two tries to get into Smash. Which Fire Emblem character still deserves a spot? Follow for more gaming history.
